Three.js r162 (0.162.0), MIT license: see LICENSE in this directory.
Used only when the device can create WebGL1 but cannot create WebGL2.
The current WebGL2 renderer remains r185.

Pinned upstream source:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r162

three.module.min.js: build/three.module.min.js (unmodified)
Timer.js: examples/jsm/misc/Timer.js (unmodified)
OrbitControls.js: examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
  Only change: replace the bare 'three' import with './three.module.min.js'.

Upstream release r163 removed WebGL1 support:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/wiki/Migration-Guide#162--r163
